description:
Who We Are   

 Hellbender Inc. is a Pennsylvania Benefit Corporation who partners with innovators to mature their Artificial Intelligence enabled computing sensors and produce their solutions onshore at prototype to high volumes.   

 Hellbender is intentionally forming an inclusive work environment and is committed to uplifting the historically marginalized identities including veterans, women, transgender people and underrepresented races in our community and industry. 

 Must be a U.S. Person          

   Job Summary   

 We're looking for a Robotics Algorithm Engineer to design, implement, and optimize the algorithms that power our AI computer vision systems. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering and applied mathematics, translating theoretical models into robust, real-time solutions that run on physical hardware.   

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities   

 
 Design and implement algorithms for motion planning, trajectory optimization, and robotic control (e.g., D*, PRM, MPC, GCS, graph planners, sampling planners, trajectory optimization, learned neural planners, etc.)   

 Develop perception pipelines including SLAM, sensor fusion, object detection, and localization using LiDAR, Event, frame, and stereo cameras, IMUs, RADARs, and other sensors (e.g. SLAM, SFM, EFK, UKF, graph solvers, OpenCV, etc.)  

 Build and refine kinematic and dynamic models for robotic manipulators, mobile platforms, or multi-body systems  

 Optimize deep learning and classical CV algorithms for real-time inference on embedded/edge hardware (e.g., GPUs, NPUs, FPGAs)  

 Validate and refine algorithms through physical hardware in the loop testing before product deployment  

 Profile and debug latency, throughput, and accuracy tradeoffs across the perception-to-control pipeline   

 Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and software teams to integrate algorithms into full robotic systems  

 Analyze test data to debug performance issues and improve system reliability and safety  

 Document technical designs, experiments, and results for internal and external stakeholders     

 
 Qualifications, Skills, and Attributes   

 
 Masters's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or related field  

 5+ years of experience developing robotics algorithms in a research or production environment   

 Strong proficiency in C++ and/or Python   

 Solid foundation in linear algebra, probability/statistics, and control theory

 Experience with ROS/ROS2 or comparable robotics middleware    

 Hands-on experience with at least one of: motion planning, SLAM, computer vision, or sensor fusion   

 Experience testing and validating algorithms on physical robotic hardware

 
 Due to the nature of Hellbender’s funding, this position requires US citizenship or Permanent Resident status.    

 Compensation   

 Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.   

 Benefits   

 
 5% employer 401(k) contribution, with no match required

 10% contribution to the employee equity program

 100% of health, dental, and vision premiums paid for employees and their families, including domestic partners

 100% of life and disability insurance premiums paid

 10 holidays, two company-wide shutdown weeks, and 15 hours of PTO accrued per month

 4 weeks of parental leave

 
 Work Location   

 Pittsburgh    

 Opportunity for Advancement   

 Hellbender is a growing business and follows a policy that prioritizes internal promotions. As new positions are created, new opportunities for advancement will be created as well.
